# JobTeaser

> > JobTeaser is Europe's leading student and graduate recruitment platform connecting young talent with employers for internships, apprenticeships, and entry-level positions.

JobTeaser operates across multiple European markets including France and Germany, partnering with major employers like Groupe TF1, Bouygues Construction, Imerys, and mc2i. The platform provides career advice, company profiles with team structures, and job matching services specifically designed for students and recent graduates seeking their first professional opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Student jobs and internships
- Apprenticeships and entry-level positions
- Career advice for graduates (Berufseinstieg)
- Employer branding and recruitment
- Company profiles and team structures
- French job market (Paris, Lyon, Lille, Nantes, Toulouse)
- German job market (Deutschland)
- Consulting careers
- Resume and application tips
- Workplace skills and professional development
- Labor law (Arbeitsrecht)
- Part-time work and contracts
- Career centers and university partnerships

## Platform Overview

- [JobTeaser - Internship, apprenticeship, first job, your next job is on JobTeaser!](https://jobteaser.com/): Homepage for JobTeaser job platform targeting students and graduates
- [JobTeaser Deutschland - Praktikum, Studierendenjob oder der erste Job](https://www.jobteaser.com/de): German homepage for JobTeaser student job portal
